comments.content: Awesome setup! Great to see clean architecture and Docker network isolation in action.
Thanks Sarah! The API gateway internal expose pattern completely eliminated port conflicts.
In Tokio, bounding your `mpsc::channel(buffer)` to 256 messages per socket with `poll_ready` backpressure yields rock solid stability.
We solved FOUC by embedding an inline `<script>` before `<html>` paint that checks `localStorage` and sets the `data-theme` attribute synchronously.
Always sort your batch records deterministically by primary key ID before issuing `ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE`. This completely prevents deadlock cycle graphs in Postgres.
The capsule visual is spot-on! Multi-tier container networks make local and prod parity trivial.
Singleflight mutex is a lifesaver for high-traffic keys. Great find Maya!
